text:
[Act: hindu-marriage
 Chapter: Preliminary
 Section: 1::Short title and extent.
]


(1) This Act may be called the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.
(2) It extends to the whole of India 2***, and applies also to Hindus domiciled in the territories to which this Act extends who are outside the said territories.
Note: footnote 1 on page 5 belongs to the Act number line (ACT NO. 25 OF 1955), the territories the Act has been extended to.
